title: pm-dispatch: a project-run seat form — seat post as a stub, posture and ledger in the Claude Code project, dispatch order in the card thread, branch named before the thread opens; 项目总监 → 总监席 (maintainer's word 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二 (`.claude/**`, the lane table's `domain:skills` row); grade suggested p2; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287), in one PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (Tier S) plus the ratchet ceiling rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. The card thread runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, the project's thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

The research memo (五张决裁卡, recommended letters 「1B 2A 3B 4B 5B」, plus section 9 on naming and skill loading) was presented at 04:03Z and 04:28Z. The maintainer answered:

> 同意，你现在就立卡派发处理。

Earlier in the same thread, the facts this card rests on:

> 我现在测试下来 claude code projects 非常好用，拍一个fable调研一下我们之前的车队机制改如何优化以及尽量过渡到 projects 模式。
> 我的车队还有一个核心痛点是我有很多claude code 20x账户，分别在运行。
> 现在的命名也有问题，Claude code 叫projects，我们之前有一个项目总监

## What was measured (this project, 2026-10-22 14:22Z – 10-23 03:46Z)

- A Claude Code project is single-account: its threads, memory, shared folder and inter-thread messages never cross accounts. GitHub stays the only cross-account bus; the seat post, the six-state labels, `Claim:` and the fleet bot are exactly that bus and stay.
- The seat-post protocol (`seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉, `seat-post-protocol.md`) was written for a seat with no memory and no threads, so posture, ledger and shift narrative all go into the post body. A project already carries those, so every one of them was written twice: seating a seat cost 3–5 relay writes, dispatching one card 6–10 (claim 2–3, order read-back 1, ACCEPT 1, landing 1–2, close-out 1–2); #6023 carries 439 comments; this account fired 100 `fleet-write` runs between 00:56Z and 03:36Z on 10-23 alone.
- Of the seat post's four sections, other accounts read three facts: which account holds the lane, who is seated, the hot-file serial queue.
- The card-thread handshake (thread pushes an empty branch → seat writes `Claim:` → thread starts) took 5–10 minutes per card (#24907: 14:39Z → 14:51Z).
- The protocol's round report (`seat-lifecycle.md` 〈轮次报告与节奏〉) was not written once in two days; the thread checklist carried it.
- No seat had a Routine; the issue side was never patrolled, and a seat that hit the usage wall (17:56Z → 21:04Z) left three landed-ready PRs unwatched.
- The protocol names 「项目总监 (Project Director)」 (SKILL.md L56, L274; `lanes/director.md` L1; `lanes/skills.md` once) and 「项目协调者」 (PR #25255's `coordinator.md`), while the platform calls the container itself 项目 (a Project) and GitHub's board an org Project.

## Wanted

A **project-run seat form** in pm-dispatch, beside the Routine-seat form, chosen when the seat session is a project thread (the `mode:thread` condition already in `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉):

1. **Seat post = stub.** Body holds only: seated account · the project's name · seating time · the hot-file serial queue · one pointer line 「posture and ledger live in the project」 · an optional wall note (「本席撞墙，预计 HH:MM 恢复」). Posture, inherited ledger, shift narrative and round reports are ⛔ not written to the post. Title, assignee and the seating audit comment stay as today. Hand-over to ANOTHER account still writes the clock-out brief comment (that is the one cross-account read).
2. **Dispatch order rides the card thread's opening message**, written by the coordinator when it opens the thread; `/mnt/project-files/<seat>/dispatch-<N>.md` is no longer required; the card's dispatch comment keeps one pointer line.
3. **Branch named before the thread opens.** The seat claims first (assignee + `pm:dispatched` + `Claim:` naming the branch the coordinator will give the thread), then asks for the thread; the thread verifies the newest `Claim:` names its branch as today and starts at once. The empty-branch probe push is dropped.
4. **Wake = events + one patrol routine per project.** PR side: `subscribe_pr_activity` on every card PR (already a rule). Issue side: one project routine every 2–4 hours runs the collection step of `execution-duties.md` for every lane the project holds (unlock scan, hold release, stale premise, awaiting-landing list, wall note). The per-seat Routine, the self-bound cron and the cross-wall timer chain in `seat-lifecycle.md` do not apply to this form.
5. **Round report = the thread checklist**; the five health figures move to the project's daily digest (the 总监项目's routine), ⛔ not a chat table per round.
6. **Naming.** 「项目总监」→「总监席」 (SKILL.md L56, L274; `lanes/director.md` L1; `lanes/skills.md`), 「项目协调者」→「协调者」 (in #25255's `coordinator.md`, re-pointed by its author after this lands, as #25344 did for item 5), GitHub's org Project →「看板」 (`rest-channel.md` L78). The Claude Code project is 「项目」; the project hosting the director seat is 「总监项目」, a project holding lanes is 「车道项目」.

Rule after the change, in one sentence: **GitHub keeps what another account reads (six-state labels, assignee, `Claim:`/`Release:`, the seat stub, the PR and its ACCEPT, the ruling record); the project keeps the working layer (posture, ledger, orders, round reports, memory).**

Out of this card's scope: the account topology itself (which account holds which lane — the maintainer assigns it per project instructions), the decision-card landing authorization trial, the director project's inbox-scan routine, and any `AGENTS.md` (Tier H) line.

## Acceptance

- `seat-lifecycle.md` / `seat-post-protocol.md` carry the stub template and say which form applies when; `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 carries items 2–4; `coordinator.md` (after #25255 lands) points at them, ⛔ no second copy.
- `git grep -n '项目总监' -- .claude/skills` returns nothing; `git grep -n '总监席' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` hits L56 and L274's successors.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` green: new lines are paid for by deleting Routine-seat-only lines that the project form makes conditional (the self-bound cron, the hourly cross-wall Routine, the `send_later` accelerator), ceilings lowered where a file shrank; `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` green.
- The three seat posts this project holds (#19287, #6023, hotcrm#1353) are rewritten to the stub on their next write-side refresh — by the seats, ⛔ not by this PR.
- Tier S landing: a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on the head, then the owning seat lands it on the maintainer's word.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "pm-dispatch project-run seat form seat post stub ledger in Claude Code project dispatch order card thread event-driven wake session start hook" → 40 hits; the top ten are #25219 (open, PR #25255 — the coordinator reference this card builds on, not a duplicate), #25185 (closed — introduced `mode:thread`), #24585, #20966, #21118, #19287, #20154 (closed — posture not inherited through the brief), #22060 (open tracking — rule-text diet; this card deletes lines, so it serves that program), #18917, #7623. None defines the project-run seat form or the stub. **New.**

Dedupe words: `project-run seat form seat post stub` · `dispatch order in card thread opening message` · `rename 项目总监 总监席`.
